name: Mempool
description: The full-featured Bitcoin block explorer: mempool visualisation, fees, addresses, mining stats — privacy-first, no third-party APIs.
compose:
services:
  mempool:
    image: mempool/mempool:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
    environment:
      MEMPOOL_NETWORK: "mainnet"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/backend/cache
    restart: unless-stopped
